bullets.title: Amazon’s internal leadership principles
bullets.note: Pair it with [Every Amazon Shareholder Letter in a Single Downloadable PDF](https://medium.com/@austenallred/every-amazon-shareholder-letter-as-downloadable-pdf-4eb2ae886018). Jeff Bezos ([@jeffbezos](https://twitter.com/jeffbezos)) never ceases to amaze, and these letters really highlight how prescient and strategic he and Amazon have been since the 1990s. If you prefer a shortened version via audio, [this is worth a shot](https://founders.simplecast.com/episodes/jeff-bezos-shareholder-letters-all-of-t-hAgb6DJ6) and includes some fun trivia (e.g., What was the original name idea for Amazon.com? Click on this: [Relentless.com](http://relentless.com)…). Big hat tip to Ricardo of [Most Recommended Books](https://mostrecommendedbooks.com/), whose site is also worth checking out.

bullets.title: Wolfwalkers
bullets.note: I watched this with a friend’s family, several young kids included, and we all loved it. Short description: “A young apprentice hunter and her father journey to Ireland to help wipe out the last wolf pack. But everything changes when she befriends a free-spirited girl from a mysterious tribe rumored to transform into wolves by night.” It has a [100% audience score](https://www.rottentomatoes.com/m/wolfwalkers) on Rotten Tomatoes, and you can [find the trailer here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d_Z_tybgPgg).

bullets.title: Wrestling Coaches Strip in Protest at the 2016 Olympics, a breakdown
bullets.note: This was sent to me by a former Olympian. It’s tragic, hilarious, and nearly unbelievable on several levels. Thanks, Matty T!
